source: AfricanFinancials HY2026 summary of Express Kenya Plc unaudited results for the six months ended 30 June 2026. Unit KES. Revenue from contracts with customers KES 9.88m against KES 56.66m of direct costs, giving the printed gross loss of KES 46.77m; other operating income KES 298.71m produced an operating profit of KES 236.67m and a net profit of KES 242.58m against a KES 125.02m loss in the prior period. Revenue less Cost of Sales reproduces the printed gross loss, which is the arithmetic gate this row set passed. Operating Expenses, Profit Before Tax, Finance Costs and Income Tax are left empty because the published summary prints no operating expense, pre tax or tax line for the half year.
source_note: FY2025 column transcribed from the audited extract for the year ended 31 December 2025 (Shs'000 in the source, stored here in KES). Every subtotal ties: Revenue 21,265 less direct costs 100,179 = gross loss 78,914; gross loss less administration 14,872 less other operating expenses 11,424 plus other operating income and impairment reversals 1,098 = operating loss 104,112; operating loss less finance costs 51,566 = loss before tax 155,678; loss before tax plus tax credit 30,659 = loss for the year 125,019; loss per share 2.62 on 47,711,000 shares. The source extract did not print the FY2025 split between other operating income and impairment reversal, so those two rows are left empty for FY2025. Gross Profit, Cost of Sales, Operating Profit (EBIT), Gross Margin and Operating Margin were also recomputed for the earlier years by identity from the rows already in the file; that identity reproduces the audited FY2024 figures (gross loss 71,465, operating loss 95,831) exactly. Ratios use the audited 31 December 2025 balance sheet (total assets 1,468,971, total liabilities 996,787, total equity 472,184). | CRON 20261004_1032: blank cell filled from the file's own duplicate statement row carrying the same line under an issuer label (validated Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax equals Net Profit). | CRON 20261004_1043: Net Finance Costs for FY2025 filled as the negation of the file's own Finance Costs row for that year, the exact relation its Net Finance Costs row already holds on every period the two rows share.
